description: This file defines the class 'hostIf_WiFi_AccessPoint' which models a WiFi Access Point object for TR-069 management, including its properties and methods for retrieving configuration and status information.

classes.name: hostIf_WiFi_AccessPoint
classes.description: Represents a WiFi Access Point object with properties and methods for TR-069 management.

methods.name: get_hostIf_WiFi_AccessPoint_Enable
methods.description: Enables or disables this access point.

methods.name: get_hostIf_WiFi_AccessPoint_Status
methods.description: Retrieves the current status of the access point, such as Disabled, Enabled, Error_Misconfigured, or Error.

methods.name: get_hostIf_WiFi_AccessPoint_Alias
methods.description: Retrieves the alias of the access point for addressing.

methods.name: get_hostIf_WiFi_AccessPoint_SSIDReference
methods.description: Gets the path name of the associated SSID table row.

methods.name: get_hostIf_WiFi_AccessPoint_SSIDAdvertisementEnabled
methods.description: Checks if beacons include the SSID name.

methods.name: get_hostIf_WiFi_AccessPoint_RetryLimit
methods.description: Gets the maximum number of retransmissions for a packet.

methods.name: get_hostIf_WiFi_AccessPoint_WMMCapability
methods.description: Checks if WiFi Multimedia (WMM) Access Categories are supported.

methods.name: get_hostIf_WiFi_AccessPoint_UAPSDCapability
methods.description: Checks if WMM Unscheduled Automatic Power Save Delivery (U-APSD) is supported.

methods.name: get_hostIf_WiFi_AccessPoint_WMMEnable
methods.description: Checks if WMM support is enabled.

methods.name: get_hostIf_WiFi_AccessPoint_UAPSDEnable
methods.description: Checks if U-APSD support is enabled.

methods.name: get_hostIf_WiFi_AccessPoint_AssociatedDeviceNumberOfEntries
methods.description: Retrieves the number of associated devices.
